Facts:
Ashoka, the grandson of Chandragupta Maurya, 
ascended the throne of the Mauryan Empire around 268 BCE.

The Kalinga War, fought between the Mauryan Empire
 under Ashoka and the state of Kalinga, led to massive bloodshed and 
 loss of life. It deeply impacted Ashoka, leading him to embrace Buddhism.

Following the Kalinga War, 
Ashoka converted to Buddhism and vowed to lead by 
principles of peace and non-violence.
